hero.title: Apply for Benefits
hero.subtitle: One application for Medicaid, HAWK-I, Food Assistance, FIP, and more.

screen.title: Apply for State-X Medicaid
screen.desc: Health coverage for you and your family. Most people finish in 20–25 minutes. We'll check what programs you may qualify for and walk you through the next steps.
screen.tile1Desc: Children, adults, parents, and pregnant residents on a single application.
screen.tile2Desc: Your information is encrypted and shared only with State-X HHS.
screen.tile3Desc: Step away and pick up where you left off — saved on your device.
screen.alertTitle: What to gather before you start
screen.alertDesc: Date of birth and Social Security Number for everyone applying · most recent pay stubs or a recent tax return · current health insurance details if anyone in your household has coverage.
screen.fineprint: By continuing, you agree that the information you provide is true and complete to the best of your knowledge. Knowingly providing false information may be a federal offense.

legal.nonDiscrimination: State-X HHS does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, age, or disability. Free language assistance services are available.
